title: Seattle weather with three y axes
intent: Compare daily temperature, precipitation, and wind without forcing unlike units onto one y scale.
features: left axis and stacked right axes

source.title: Recharts Line Bar Area Composed Chart

ai.create: Create one chart from Seattle weather observations that uses a left temperature axis, an independent right precipitation axis for bars, and a second right wind axis for points.
ai.maintain: Select a different weather window while preserving source dates, units, named scale bindings, stacked right axes, mark order, colors, and cast-free channel inference.
